Image resizer

The right dimensions, every time. Free, simple, and right here in your browser.

Preparing your tool…
A little possibility, waiting.Your result will appear here.
A useful little guide

How to use image resizer

Set a new image width and height in pixels. Keep the original aspect ratio for natural proportions, or choose exact dimensions when stretching is intentional.

  1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
  2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
  3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.
A real use case

Try this next

Resize a 1920 × 1080 image to 1280 × 720 while keeping its 16:9 proportions.

A detail to keep in mind

Enlarging an image changes its dimensions but does not recover missing photographic detail.

Questions, answered.

Is image resizer free to use?

Yes. This tool is part of Nepocore’s free browser toolkit. There is no paid tier, file-download gate or application account required.

What should I check before using the result?

Enlarging an image changes its dimensions but does not recover missing photographic detail.

Does this tool upload my files or text?

The tool processes its input in your browser. File contents and text are not sent to a processing server. See the privacy page for local storage and hosting details.
